hints.databaseUnavailable: existing Docker-backed pages remain available; run portta db status
hints.panelLimit: this is a panel limit, not a Docker one

readOnly: the panel is running in read-only mode
bridgeClosed: bridge closed; the service itself was not touched
shareDangling: share points at a container that is gone

actionRefused.gatewayContainer: the panel does not stop or remove its own infrastructure

access.alreadyOpen: a bridge is already open for this service

override.notIntegrated: overrides apply only to integrated projects

dynamic.notWritable: the dynamic configuration directory is not writable

github.forbidden: the GitHub App lacks permission for this action

docker.accessDenied: this container is outside the panel's allowlist
